fix(usage): today counts each API response once, however many session files hold a copy of it (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.au0)

A forked or resumed session's transcript copies the earlier session's
responses under their original ids, with a forkedFrom mark or without
one. Day buckets are now keyed by response, so a directory's day sums
and a session's own days count each copy once, including when the file
it was copied from is gone or unread. Buckets are kept only for the
days today reads, so the ids held grow with a day's work.

ci: the Release workflow's checks run as parallel jobs under one Test gate, inside 5 minutes (#938)

The Test job ran lint, typecheck, the three test tiers and the Rust tests one
after another on one runner: ~7.5 min on main, and the worker tier alone held
~300 s of wall time. They now run as parallel jobs (static checks, unit, four
worker shards, process + e2e), each capped at 4 minutes, and Test is the one
gate over them: it joins every job's test records, reports by layer, and names
any job that did not pass.

Refs brandon-unfiled-3248.o44h
